Grizzly_Massive_Broad_Skull.description: The Grizzly_Massive_Broad_Skull is a formidable cranial structure, broad and heavy with the strength and resilience of a mighty bear, granting unparalleled physical power and constitution, and empowering the user with the fearsome skills of Headbutt and Intimidate.

Polar_Bear_Elongated_Skull.description: This elongated skull, a grotesque mutation in the lineage of polar bears, embodies raw strength and keen perception, its massive jaw filled with deadly teeth capable of delivering bone-crushing bites, while its enlarged brain cavity hints at an unnaturally heightened awareness of its surroundings.

Black_Bear_Slender_Skull.description: This eerie, slender ursine skull, with its hauntingly large eye sockets, grants increased agility and heightened perception, allowing its bearer to move with the grace and keen senses of a shadowy predator in the darkened forests of the realm.

Panda_Rounded_Heavy_Skull.description: The Panda_Rounded_Heavy_Skull is a fearsome cranial augmentation, a massive ursine cephalon sheathed in bony armor that not only boosts its bearer's constitution but also grants them a natural barrier against physical blows, along with the innate ability to resist bludgeoning damage and block attacks effectively.

Sun_Bear_Short_Snouted_Skull.description: The Sun_Bear_Short_Snouted_Skull, a relic of the Ursine warriors, is a marvel of dexterity and agility, its ethereal presence granting its bearer unmatched swiftness and the ability to execute lightning-fast maneuvers, as if the spirit of the nimble bear itself guides their every move.

Sloth_Bear_Protruding_Skull.description: The Sloth_Bear_Protruding_Skull is a fearsome cranial enhancement, an ursine relic that bulges ominously from the forehead, granting its bearer a heightened sense of constitution and an extended reach, with the mystical ability to siphon life force and endure the harshest trials.

Spectacled_Bear_Marked_Skull.description: Etched with ancient runes and adorned with spectacles that seem to capture the essence of a bygone era, the Spectacled_Bear_Marked_Skull is a macabre masterpiece that enhances the wearer's perception and charisma, granting them an uncanny ability to洞察周围环境并施展魅力。

Cave_Bear_Gigantic_Dome.description: This colossal cave bear's skull, a veritable fortress of bone, bulges with powerful muscles and is encased in a thick layer of natural armor, making it a nearly impenetrable cephalon that enhances its already formidable strength and constitution, granting it the ability to intimidate foes, resist bludgeoning attacks, and knock down even the mightiest adversaries.

Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Skull.description: The Rotten Skull of the Zombie Bear is a grotesque amalgamation of decayed ursine cranial matter, festering with a toxic aura that clouds the minds of those nearby while granting the creature resilience against its own putrid poisons.

Spirit_Bear_Ghostly_Cranium.description: This spectral cranium, once the formidable skull of a great spirit bear, now hovers with an ethereal glow, its wisdom and magical acumen far surpassing its mortal form, granting its bearer the elusive presence of true stealth and the arcane sight to pierce through veils of illusion.
